title: The Landstar Link, Spring 2026
summary: In this issue of The Landstar Link newsletter, you’ll see how the network came together at the 2026 Agent Convention while celebrating achievements and building momentum for the road ahead.
body_markdown:
In this issue of The Landstar Link newsletter, you’ll see how the network came together at the 2026 Agent Convention—ALL IN for safety, security, and service—while celebrating achievements and building momentum for the road ahead.


Inside this issue:


- Agent Convention highlights, awards, and leadership insights
- Grow Your Star stories focused on collaboration and growth strategies
- Recognition of agents and leaders driving safety and service excellence
- Network awards and updates showcasing industry leadership
- Giving back stories that reflect the heart of the Landstar network


Enjoy the issue and scan the QR code in the newsletter to share your story—you may be featured in a future edition or on social media.


[Read the latest edition](https://bit.ly/4v1AegC)
